prompt: The character in the picture moves with the body it actually has. It is fast asleep. Only its slow breathing moves it, in and out, the whole time. Very slow. Anything this description names drifts in when it is wanted, moves as it is used, and drifts off again by the end; nothing else appears, and the flat empty background behind it stays exactly as it is. The camera does not move.
